name: title
on_screen: Open-Source Speech to Text — What You Can Verify
text: Looking for open-source speech to text? Here is what to verify before installing.

name: public_repo
text: AI Dictation's Apple, Windows, and Android clients are public on GitHub.

name: license
text: The repository uses MIT. Third-party components keep their own licenses, so check the notices.

name: build
on_screen: Inspect each client · Build from source
text: You can inspect each platform folder and follow the build instructions yourself.

name: offline_cloud
on_screen: Open source does not automatically mean offline
text: Open source does not mean offline. Supported devices can recognize speech locally; cloud transcription sends audio remotely.

name: privacy
on_screen: Offline recognition is not necessarily a fully offline workflow
text: Cloud cleanup can send transcript text after local recognition. Disable cloud features when nothing should leave your device.

name: cta
text: Inspect the code on GitHub, or download AI Dictation at aidictation dot com.
